abyssactorsbackstage.name: Abyss Actors Back Stage
abyssactorsbackstage.desc: If you have 2 "Abyss Actor" cards in your Pendulum Zones: Add 2 "Abyss Actor" Pendulum Monsters with different names from your Deck to your Extra Deck face-up. You can only activate 1 "Abyss Actors Back Stage" per turn.

aircrackingstorm.name: Air Cracking Storm
aircrackingstorm.desc: Equip only to a Machine monster. When that attacking monster destroys your opponent's monster by battle: You can activate this effect; it can make a second attack during this Battle Phase. Your other monsters cannot attack the turn you activate this effect.

allyofjusticeenemycatcher.name: Ally of Justice Enemy Catcher
allyofjusticeenemycatcher.desc: When this card is Normal Summoned, you can take control of 1 face-down Defense Position monster your opponent controls, until the End Phase of this turn.

altergeisthexstia.name: Altergeist Hexstia
altergeisthexstia.desc:
2 "Altergeist" monsters
Gains ATK equal to the original ATK of each "Altergeist" monster it points to. When a Spell/Trap Card or effect is activated (Quick Effect): You can Tribute 1 "Altergeist" monster this card points to; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card. If this card is sent from the field to the GY: You can add 1 "Altergeist" card from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Altergeist Hexstia" once per turn.

amazonesssage.name: Amazoness Sage
amazonesssage.desc: At the end of the Damage Step, if this card attacked and is still on the field: Target 1 Spell/Trap your opponent controls; destroy that target.

ancientwarriorssagathreevisits.name: Ancient Warriors Saga - Three Visits
ancientwarriorssagathreevisits.desc: During your Main Phase, if you Normal or Special Summon an "Ancient Warriors" monster(s): You can target 1 of those monsters; add 1 "Ancient Warriors" monster with a different name from your Deck to your hand. If this card is sent from the Spell & Trap Zone to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 "Ancient Warriors" monster from your hand. You can only use each effect of "Ancient Warriors Saga - Three Visits" once per turn. Send this card to the GY during your 2nd Standby Phase after activation.

angelofzera.name: Angel of Zera
angelofzera.desc:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
This card gains 100 ATK for each of your opponent's banished cards. During the Standby Phase of the next turn after this card was banished: Special Summon this banished card. You can only use the effect of "Angel of Zera" once per turn.

blackwingausterthesouthwind.name: Blackwing - Auster the South Wind

bujingiturtle.name: Bujingi Turtle
bujingiturtle.desc: During either player's turn, when a card or effect is activated that targets a "Bujin" monster you control (except during the Damage Step): You can banish this card from your Graveyard; negate that effect.

capacitorstalker.name: Capacitor Stalker
capacitorstalker.desc: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can target 1 other Cyberse monster you control; while this face-up monster is on the field, that monster gains 800 ATK. If this card in the Monster Zone is destroyed by a card effect and sent to the GY: Each player takes 800 damage. You can only use this effect of "Capacitor Stalker" once per turn.

ddsprite.name: D.D. Sprite
ddsprite.desc: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by banishing 1 face-up monster you control. If you Summon this way, during your next Standby Phase: Return the banished monster to the field.

doomzxiizerodrastea.name: DoomZ XII Zero - Drastea
doomzxiizerodrastea.desc: You can target 1 "DoomZ" card you control; destroy it, and if you do, Special Summon this card from your hand, then you can equip 1 Equip Spell from your Deck to this card. While this card is equipped with an Equip Card (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon 1 WIND Machine Xyz Monster from your Extra Deck with the same Rank as this card's Level, and if you do, attach this card and its Equip Cards to that monster as material (this is treated as an Xyz Summon). You can only use each effect of "DoomZ XII Zero - Drastea" once per turn.

dragonmaidsheou.name: Dragonmaid Sheou
dragonmaidsheou.desc:
1 "Dragonmaid" monster + 1 Level 5 or higher Dragon monster
During each Standby Phase: You can Special Summon 1 Level 9 or lower "Dragonmaid" monster from your hand or GY. When your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card, also, after that, return this card to the Extra Deck, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "House Dragonmaid" from your Extra Deck. You can only use each effect of "Dragonmaid Sheou" once per turn.

duckermobilecannon.name: DUCKER Mobile Cannon
duckermobilecannon.desc: FLIP: Target 1 Level 4 monster in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand.

dustknight.name: Dust Knight
dustknight.desc: FLIP: Send 1 EARTH monster from your Deck to the Graveyard.

eisbahn.name: Eisbahn
eisbahn.desc: If a non-WATER monster(s) is Normal or Special Summoned while you control a WATER monster: Change that Summoned monster to Defense Position.

famotorhometransport.name: F.A. Motorhome Transport
famotorhometransport.desc:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
Gains ATK equal to its Level x 300. Each time a "F.A." Spell/Trap Card or effect is activated: You can increase the Level of this card by 1. This card gains the following effect(s), based on its current Level.
● Level 11 or higher: Cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects.
● Level 13 or higher: Once per turn: You can target 1 "F.A." monster in your GY; Special Summon it.

firstofthedragons.name: First of the Dragons
firstofthedragons.desc:
2 Normal Monsters
Must be Fusion Summoned and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. You can only control 1 "First of the Dragons". This card cannot be destroyed by battle, except by battle with a Normal Monster, and is unaffected by other monsters' effects.

flowercardianpaulowniawithphoenix.name: Flower Cardian Paulownia with Phoenix
flowercardianpaulowniawithphoenix.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 1 Level 12 "Flower Cardian" monster, except "Flower Cardian Paulownia with Phoenix". If this card is Special Summoned: Draw 1 card, and if you do, show it, then you can Special Summon it if it is a "Flower Cardian" monster. Otherwise, send it to the Graveyard. Once per turn, when this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: You can draw 1 card.

gagagarevenge.name: Gagagarevenge
gagagarevenge.desc: Target 1 "Gagaga" monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it and equip it with this card. When this card leaves the field, destroy the equipped monster. When this card is sent to the Graveyard because the equipped monster was used as an Xyz Material: All Xyz Monsters you currently control gain 300 ATK.

greed.name: Greed
greed.desc: Each time a player draws cards because of a card effect, they take 500 damage during the End Phase for each card drawn by the card effect.

kingssarcophagus.name: King's Sarcophagus
kingssarcophagus.desc: "Horus" monsters you control cannot be destroyed by card effects that do not target them. You can send 1 card from your hand to the GY; send 1 "Horus" monster from your Deck to the GY. You can only use this effect of "King's Sarcophagus" up to four times per turn. Once per turn, at the start of the Damage Step, if your "Horus" monster battles an opponent's monster: You can send that opponent's monster to the GY.

magicalmusketeerkidbrave.name: Magical Musketeer Kidbrave
magicalmusketeerkidbrave.desc: During either player's turn, you can activate "Magical Musket" Spell/Trap Cards from your hand. If a Spell/Trap Card is activated in this card's column: You can discard 1 "Magical Musket" card; draw 2 cards. You can only use this effect of "Magical Musketeer Kidbrave" once per turn.

malisswhitebinder.name: Maliss <Q> White Binder
malisswhitebinder.desc:
2+ monsters, including a "Maliss" monster
If this card is Special Summoned: You can target up to 3 cards in any GY(s); banish them. During your Main Phase: You can Set 1 "Maliss" Trap from your Deck or GY. If this card is banished: You can pay 900 LP; Special Summon it, then you can draw 1 card. You can only use each effect of "Maliss White Binder" once per turn.

metallizingparasitelunatite.name: Metallizing Parasite - Lunatite
metallizingparasitelunatite.desc: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, if you control this monster on the field, you can equip it to a face-up monster on your side of the field as an Equip Spell Card, OR unequip the Union equipment and Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. While equipped to a monster by this card's effect, that monster will be unaffected by the effects of Spell Cards controlled by your opponent. (1 monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the monster that this card is equipped to is destroyed as a result of battle, destroy this card instead.)

nekomaneking.name: Neko Mane King
nekomaneking.desc: During your opponent's turn, when this card in your possession is sent to your Graveyard by an opponent's card effect: It becomes the End Phase of this turn.

paceslightoftheghoti.name: Paces, Light of the Ghoti
paceslightoftheghoti.desc: You can banish this card you control; Special Summon 1 Fish monster from your hand, except "Paces, Light of the Ghoti". During the Standby Phase of the next turn after this card was banished: You can Special Summon this banished card. During your opponent's Main Phase, if this card was Special Summoned this turn, you can (Quick Effect): Immediately after this effect resolves, Synchro Summon 1 Fish Synchro Monster using this card you control. You can only use each effect of "Paces, Light of the Ghoti" once per turn.

redsupernovadragon.name: Red Supernova Dragon
redsupernovadragon.desc:
3 Tuners + 1+ non-Tuner Synchro Monsters
Must first be Synchro Summoned. Gains 500 ATK for each Tuner in your GY. Cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects. Once per turn, when your opponent's monster effect is activated, or when an opponent's monster declares an attack (Quick Effect): You can activate this effect; banish this card, also banish all cards your opponent controls. Once per turn, during your next End Phase after this card was banished by its own effect: Special Summon this banished card.

refusion.name: Re-Fusion
refusion.desc: Activate this card by paying 800 LP, then target 1 Fusion Monster in your GY; Special Summon it and equip it with this card. When this card is destroyed, banish the equipped monster.

relinquishedthewickedeyeofillusion.name: Relinquished the Wicked Eye of Illusion
relinquishedthewickedeyeofillusion.desc: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Relinquished the Wicked Eye of Illusion". Your opponent takes any battle damage you would have taken from battles involving this card. You can only use each of the following effects of "Relinquished the Wicked Eye of Illusion" once per turn. If this card is in your hand: You can Tribute 2 monsters; Special Summon this card (this is treated as a Ritual Summon). During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can target 1 Effect Monster your opponent controls; negate its effects, and if you do, equip it to this card as an Equip Spell that gives it 2000 ATK.

runicktip.name: Runick Tip
runicktip.desc:
Activate 1 of these effects, but skip your next Battle Phase after activation;
● Add 1 "Runick" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Runick Tip", then banish the top card of your opponent's Deck.
● Special Summon 1 "Runick" monster from your Extra Deck to the Extra Monster Zone.
You can only activate 1 "Runick Tip" per turn.

shienssmokesignal.name: Shien's Smoke Signal
shienssmokesignal.desc: Add 1 Level 3 or lower "Six Samurai" monster from your Deck to your hand.

symphonicwarriorbasses.name: Symphonic Warrior Basses
symphonicwarriorbasses.desc: Once per turn, you can select 1 face-up "Symphonic Warrior" monster on the field. Increase its Level by the number of cards in your hand; this increase lasts until the End Phase. You can remove from play this card from your Graveyard to select 1 face-up "Symphonic Warrior" monster you control, and increase its Level by the number of cards in your hand; this increase lasts until the End Phase.

typhoon.name: Typhoon
typhoon.desc: Target 1 face-up Spell/Trap on the field; destroy it. If your opponent controls 2 or more Spells/Traps and you control no Spells/Traps, you can activate this card from your hand.

voltester.name: Voltester
voltester.desc: If this card is Special Summoned to a zone a Link Monster points to: Destroy all Link Monsters that point to this card, then destroy all other monsters that those Link Monsters pointed to, and follow the Link Arrows of all those destroyed monsters, destroying everything they point to, and repeating the process, until there are no more to destroy. (This card cannot be destroyed by this effect.) You can only use this effect of "Voltester" once per turn.

vylonsoldier.name: Vylon Soldier
vylonsoldier.desc: When this card declares an attack: You can target monsters your opponent controls, up to the number of Equip Cards equipped to this card; change those targets' battle positions.
